title: Prepare one evidence-bound Project setup command offline

requirements.invariant: Project setup prepares one observable operation containing stable Project identity, one stable existing-or-new Client relationship, selected categories and exact nullable allocations. Project name is required; raw optional creation description reuses the verified ProjectDescriptionReplacement rule so outer whitespace is removed and empty/whitespace-only input becomes nil. Attachment handling remains separate.

An existing Client choice uses exact active ClientID evidence; a new Client choice uses a separately preallocated ClientID and validated display name. A new-Client ID that already identifies a represented existing Client is refused locally, while any unrepresented collision remains an authoritative-apply concern. Free-text Client name is never relationship identity, and Project setup cannot rename, archive, merge or reassign Clients.

A Project with no enabled budget categories is valid. The target preparation contract invents no default or automatic category selection, treats allocation input order as non-semantic, and preserves exact absent, selected-null, selected-zero and selected-positive allocation intent.

Only represented active non-system category definitions are selectable for Project configuration. Category order follows the verified reference snapshot; supplied allocations are exact non-negative typed Money and inherit no source 32-bit maximum.

Preparation is a deterministic projection over the verified active-Client selection and budget-category reference snapshots. It preserves source readiness/completeness/version/time, exposes incomplete local evidence, and never interprets local visibility as current authorization.

The only command-producing call revalidates the current Client/category evidence against the preparation and exact selection fingerprint before constructing the already-verified ProjectSetupDraft and CreateProjectCommand with caller-supplied stable Project/Operation IDs, actor, contract version and finite capture time.

requirements.section: Clients, Projects, notes, preferences, and reference data
requirements.invariant: The presentation adds no Project-specific operation lifecycle, queue, port or receipt model. It derives the existing backend-neutral command only; trusted Account, Client and category authorization remains mandatory at authoritative apply.

Exactly two target-only Swift leaf paths implement and test this provider-free preparation boundary while Firebase and both app projects remain unchanged. UI layout/copy/step count, defaults, category creation, media, persistence, providers, schema/RLS/Sync, MCP, migration and production behavior do not advance.

items: ProjectSetupFormPreparation composes one exact Account-scoped ProjectExistingClientSelectionSnapshot and BudgetCategoryReferenceSnapshot, exposes existing active Clients in their verified order, exposes Project-configurable categories in canonical presentation order, and preserves each source's readiness/evidence without creating authorization.

ProjectSetupFormSelection distinguishes exact existing-Client evidence from a preallocated new-Client payload, rejects a new Client ID already represented by an existing Client, carries an explicit duplicate-free selected-category allocation set whose input order is non-semantic, and binds the form fields, selected identities plus both source snapshots to one canonical fingerprint.

ProjectSetupFormPresentation validates Project display name and canonicalizes raw optional description through ProjectDescriptionReplacement, accepts zero selected categories, preserves null/zero/positive Money, rejects negative/unknown/inactive/system/cross-Account evidence, and never performs automatic selection.

Its only command-producing function validates the selection against current matching preparation evidence before deriving ProjectSetupDraft and CreateProjectCommand; evidence changes or sibling substitution fail before any command exists.

items: Preparation and selection encode canonically with Account, ordered Client/category rows, every named source evidence field, exact selections and a SHA-256 evidence fingerprint; strict decode reconstructs through the same validators.

Partial and stale represented evidence remains explicitly usable for offline preparation, but old selection cannot produce a command after any current Client/category evidence change. Empty selection is valid; nonrepresented identities never become selectable or authoritatively absent by inference.

storageMedia.notApplicable: No AttachmentID, bytes, picker, hero image, upload, URL, retention or deletion behavior exists; media remains a separate durable receipt lifecycle.

items: Implementation stays inside provider-free LedgerTargetCore and tests and cannot link or modify either application project.

The slice cannot create visible or authoritative rows, invoke a port, persist locally, authorize, create reference categories, choose UI defaults or navigation, handle media, deploy, release or cut over.

O-023/O-024/O-025/O-026 and A-003/A-004/A-007/A-015/A-016 remain outside; current source free-text Client identity, at-least-one/preselect-all, missing-as-zero, on-the-fly category creation and silent fan-out writes are not copied.

verification.expected: Preparation preserves exact active-Client upstream order and configurable category presentation order, Account scope, independent source readiness/completeness/version/time and no default selection. Same-name Clients remain distinct; archived Clients and inactive/system categories are not selectable without leaking hidden counts.

Existing Client selection requires the exact represented active ClientID; new Client selection preserves its preallocated identity and validated display name. Unknown, archived, cross-Account and sibling-rebound existing selections fail before command derivation; a new Client ID already represented by an existing Client fails locally, while no claim is made about unrepresented authoritative collisions.

Zero selected categories and exact null/zero/positive allocations derive the verified ProjectSetupDraft and CreateProjectCommand with stable caller-supplied IDs, actor, contract and time. Equivalent allocation input order produces the same selection/command. Nil, empty and whitespace-only description become nil; outer whitespace is trimmed from nonempty description and noncanonical encoded description is refused. Duplicate, negative, unknown, inactive or system category inputs fail; no source 32-bit maximum, one-Project-currency or missing-as-zero rule appears.

Preparation and selection restart byte-identically with canonical Project name/description, every Client/category row and source query/count/completeness/quality/version/time field bound. Changed/reordered/inserted/removed source evidence, selection substitution, noncanonical description, malformed keys, nonfinite time and fingerprint tamper fail closed; allocation input reordering alone is canonical and does not change selection identity.

Ready/partial/stale and exhaustive/nonexhaustive evidence remain distinct; represented choices may be prepared offline, but unavailable identities, false absence and changed current evidence cannot produce a command. Tests assert the output contains no Principal authorization, route, port call, provider or authoritative result claim.
